scope: Newly identified query-ranking and recommendation candidates screened for tabular dense-MLP fit, anonymous access, open terms, and the all-training-rows full-batch profile.

tasks_and_splits.task_1: query-product grouped ranking, Exact/Substitute/Complement/Irrelevant graded relevance, official query-level train/test split
tasks_and_splits.official_count_note: README prose gives 2,621,738 large-version judgments, but Table 2 total and the train+test split rows sum to 2,621,288; catalog uses the internally consistent table/split total.

amazon_shopping_queries_esci.dense_mlp_fit: Only after a text featurizer or handcrafted lexical feature pipeline; the official dataset does not supply a numeric query-product feature matrix. That is outside the tabular-only input contract.

full_batch_memory.profile: [512]*5 float32 hidden activations only, one entire training partition per batch

amazon_shopping_queries_esci.saturation_pilot: Not run because tabular input contract and full-batch resource gates already fail.
amazon_shopping_queries_esci.disposition: CROSS OUT: access and open-license gates pass; task requires text processing, and largest registered full-batch model exceeds GPU memory even for the reduced ranking version.

yambda.task_semantics: Observed listens/likes/dislikes and other actions; no complete exposed candidate set or observed non-click labels. Event-type prediction is conceivable but is not a direct click/recommendation accuracy benchmark.
yambda.mlp_and_capacity: IDs are high-cardinality and would require dense one-hot input for this plain MLP profile. Even the 50M-row artifact needs about 358 GiB for [512]*5 activations if a 75% training split is used (477 GiB if all 50M rows are training data), before inputs or gradients.
yambda.saturation_pilot: Not run after task-semantics and hard full-batch resource failures.
yambda.disposition: CROSS OUT for the supervised recommendation suite, despite public ungated Apache-2.0 access.

ali_ccp.task: click-through and conversion prediction from exposed ad contexts
ali_ccp.access_and_rights: Official Tianchi route. Tianchi platform agreement limits downloaded dataset use to scientific research and education, bars commercial activity, and defers to third-party terms; this does not meet the unrestricted open-license criterion. No anonymous direct artifact GET was verified.
ali_ccp.mlp_compatibility: Sparse feature-field/value rows can be parsed for a pointwise MLP, but dense one-hot conversion is extremely wide.
ali_ccp.full_batch_memory: 42M train rows require about 400.5 GiB for [512]*5 float32 hidden activations alone.
ali_ccp.saturation_pilot: Not run after rights/access and resource failures.

wands: See WANDS_RANKING_MLP_SCREEN_20261024.json for complete anonymous checkout, hashes, row-level parsing, two full-batch vanilla MLP feature routes, metrics, and cross-out.
